arguments.command: bash -lc 'ls -la /src/libxml2; echo; grep -nR "xmlXIncludeLoadTxt" -n /src/libxml2 | head -n 20; echo; grep -nR "xmlStaticCopyNode" -n /src/libxml2 | head -n 20; echo; sed -n "1800,1870p" /src/libxml2/xinclude.c'

bash -lc 'python - << "PY"\nimport io,sys,re
p="/src/libxml2/xinclude.c"
s=open(p,'r').read()
# patch two variants for two blocks
s2=re.sub(r"node = xmlCopyNode\(ctxt->txtTab\[i\], 1\);\n\t\tgoto loaded;",
          "/* Do not reuse previously loaded text to avoid potential use-after-free. */\n\t\tbreak;",
          s)
s2=re.sub(r"node = xmlCopyNode\(ctxt->txtTab\[i\], 1\);\n\t\tgoto loaded;",
          "/* Do not reuse previously loaded text to avoid potential use-after-free. */\n\t\tbreak;",
          s2)
open(p,'w').write(s2)
print('patched')
PY'

bash -lc 'awk "BEGIN{skip=0} { if (skip>0) { skip--; next } if ($0 ~ /if \(xmlStrEqual\(URL, ctxt->txturlTab\[i\]\) \{/) { print "    if (xmlStrEqual(URL, ctxt->txturlTab[i])) {"; print "        /* Do not reuse previously loaded text to avoid use-after-free */"; print "        break;"; skip=3; next } } print }" /src/libxml2/xinclude.c > /tmp/xinclude.c && mv /tmp/xinclude.c /src/libxml2/xinclude.c'
bash -lc 'sed -i "s/node = xmlCopyNode(ctxt->txtTab[i], 1);/node = NULL; break;/" /src/libxml2/xinclude.c' && echo PATCHED || echo FAIL'

bash -lc 'ed -s /src/libxml2/xinclude.c <<"ED" 
1847,1850d
1847a
        /* Do not reuse previously loaded text to avoid use-after-free; fall through to normal loading path */
        /* skip reuse: do not copy node or goto loaded */
.
w
q
ED'

bash -lc 'perl -0777 -pe "s/node = xmlCopyNode\\(ctxt->txtTab\\[i\\], 1\\);//* reuse disabled: avoid using previously loaded text *//g" -i /src/libxml2/xinclude.c; perl -0777 -pe "s/goto loaded;//* intentionally not jumping to loaded; proceeding to full load *//g" -i /src/libxml2/xinclude.c'
bash -lc 'sed -i "s/node = xmlCopyNode(ctxt->txtTab[i], 1);//* Do not reuse previously loaded text to avoid use-after-free */;/" /src/libxml2/xinclude.c'

bash -lc 'awk "/Do not reuse previously loaded text to avoid use-after-free/ { getline; if ($0 ~ /break;/) { print "            continue;"; } else { print; } } /Do not reuse previously loaded text/ { next } { print }" /src/libxml2/xinclude.c > /tmp/xinclude.c and mv /tmp/xinclude.c /src/libxml2/xinclude.c'

bash -lc 'sed -i "s/node = xmlCopyNode(ctxt->txtTab[i], 1);//* Do not reuse previously loaded text to avoid use-after-free; fall through to normal load path *//" /src/libxml2/xinclude.c; sed -i "s/goto loaded;/break;/" /src/libxml2/xinclude.c'
bash -lc 'sed -i "s/node = xmlCopyNode(ctxt->txtTab[i], 1);//* node = xmlCopyNode(ctxt->txtTab[i], 1); *//" /src/libxml2/xinclude.c; sed -i "s/goto loaded;/break;/" /src/libxml2/xinclude.c'

bash -lc 'sed -i "s/node = xmlCopyNode(ctxt->txtTab[i], 1);//* reuse disabled: force reload from URL to avoid use-after-free */ break;/" /src/libxml2/xinclude.c; sed -i "/^[[:space:]]*goto loaded;[[:space:]]*$/d" /src/libxml2/xinclude.c'
bash -lc 'grep -nR "goto loaded" /src/libxml2/xinclude.c || true; echo ---; nl -ba /src/libxml2/xinclude.c | sed -n "1780,1860p"'

bash -lc 'perl -0777 -pe "s/for \(i = 0; i < ctxt->txtNr; i\\+\\+\\) \\{\\n\\s*if \\(xmlStrEqual\\(URL, ctxt->txturlTab\\[i\\]\\)\\) \\{\\n\\s*node = xmlCopyNode\\(ctxt->txtTab\\[i\\], 1\\);\\n\\s*goto loaded;\\n\\s*\\}\\n\\s*\\}\\n/for (i = 0; i < ctxt->txtNr; i++) {\\n    if (xmlStrEqual(URL, ctxt->txturlTab[i])) {\\n        /* Do not reuse previously loaded text to avoid use-after-free; fall through to normal load path */\\n        break;\\n    }\\n}\\n/s" -i /src/libxml2/xinclude.c' && nl -ba /src/libxml2/xinclude.c | sed -n '1840,1860p'
bash -lc 'perl -0777 -pe "s/(doc = ctxt->doc;\n\s*)break;/\1goto loaded;/s" -i /src/libxml2/xinclude.c && echo PATCHED || echo NOTPATCHED'
